name: AgentSec - Evidence Analysis Pipeline
description: Reference workflow for an authorized AgentSec deployment. The default repository mode is safe demo mode.

nodes.name: Run authorized collectors
nodes.purpose: Invoke approved scanners in a controlled Linux environment

nodes.name: Normalize evidence
nodes.purpose: Map tool output into the AgentSec finding schema

nodes.name: Score and enrich
nodes.purpose: Send normalized evidence to the Flask analysis API

nodes.name: Persist and notify
nodes.purpose: Persist the result and optionally notify the analyst
